compassionate.name: Compassionate
compassionate.greeting: Welcome, fellow cultivator. May your path be clear.
dialogue: A firm foundation grows through patience, not haste.
There is strength in helping others rise.
A thousand small efforts surpass one reckless leap.
stronger: Even a master can learn from someone who has climbed further.
Such cultivation! May your strength shelter those still beginning.
weaker: Take your time. A good foundation cannot be hurried.
familiar: It is good to see a familiar face again.
challenged: Our contest need not diminish our mutual respect.
guided: I have shared what I know. Now find your own understanding within it.
friendly: Your presence is a comfort along this difficult path.
hostile: I would rather we settled this without further bloodshed.

greetings: It is good to see another traveller upon the path.
wary: I hope we can find common ground despite our differences.
senior: Honoured senior, may your cultivation flourish.

gifts.preferred_reply: You remembered what I value. This kindness will not be forgotten.
gifts.accepted_reply: Thank you. Small kindnesses make the cultivation road easier.
gifts.refused_reply: I appreciate the thought, but perhaps someone else could use that more.
gifts.disliked_reply: I would rather you kept that, thank you.
gifts.hostile_reply: We have much to mend before I can accept an ordinary offering.
gifts.trusted_reply: Your company is gift enough. Keep this for someone who needs it.

reserved.name: Reserved
dialogue: A quiet mind gathers more than a noisy crowd.
The movement of qi reveals more than words.
Power without restraint is merely destruction.
stronger: Your spiritual presence is difficult to ignore.
Your realm is noteworthy. Perhaps we may speak as peers.
weaker: Do not mistake silence for weakness.
familiar: We have spoken before. Has anything changed?
challenged: I have not forgotten our previous challenge.
guided: What I could impart, I have imparted. Seek answers within yourself.
friendly: I find your company less distracting than most.

wary: We need not agree to coexist.
senior: Greetings, senior. I shall not disturb your practice.

gifts.preferred_reply: A useful addition to my studies. You have my thanks.
gifts.accepted_reply: I will put this to good use.
gifts.refused_reply: No. That serves no purpose in my studies.
gifts.disliked_reply: I prefer my possessions to remain clean.
gifts.hostile_reply: I have no reason to accept that from you.
gifts.trusted_reply: There is no need for another offering between us.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.greeting: Another cultivator. Perhaps a worthy rival.
dialogue: The next realm is mine to conquer.
I refuse to bend before the first obstacle.
Every setback is a challenge to overcome.
stronger: You have surpassed me. I will not remain behind forever.
weaker: You have talent, but you lack experience.
familiar: Still training? Good. So am I.
challenged: Our last challenge taught me what I must improve.
guided: I have learned from you once. Let us see how far I can go.
friendly: A worthy rival is more valuable than a hundred flatterers.
hostile: You have made this a personal contest.
taunts: Do not expect me to hold back.

greetings: One day, we should compare our progress.
wary: Our differences need not prevent a worthy contest.
senior: Your cultivation is impressive. I intend to catch up.

gifts.preferred_reply: Excellent! This will help with my next training session.
gifts.accepted_reply: A practical offering. I will make good use of it.
gifts.refused_reply: Bring something useful for training, not that.
gifts.disliked_reply: Are you mocking my training with this?
gifts.hostile_reply: If you want to make amends, bring something that shows real effort.
gifts.trusted_reply: Save your supplies. I would rather test our strength.

arrogant.name: Arrogant
arrogant.greeting: You may speak. Make it worth my time.
dialogue: My lineage has cultivated for generations. What have yours accomplished?
You should count yourself fortunate to stand in my presence.
Surely you have heard of my latest breakthrough.
stronger: That aura... Hmph. You must have stumbled upon some fortunate encounter.
weaker: You are fortunate that I have chosen to acknowledge you.
familiar: You again? Have you finally learned proper etiquette?
challenged: You had the audacity to challenge me. Such insults are not forgotten.
guided: I have imparted wisdom enough. Do not squander it.
friendly: I suppose your company is not entirely unbearable.
hostile: Keep testing my patience and you will regret it.
taunts: Even your ancestors would bow before my family name.
Do not confuse my patience with weakness.

greetings: You may consider this meeting an honour.
wary: Do not mistake my courtesy for agreement.

gifts.preferred_reply: At last, an offering suitable for someone of my standing.
gifts.accepted_reply: Acceptable. You may consider yourself fortunate.
gifts.refused_reply: You expect someone of my lineage to want that?
gifts.disliked_reply: How dare you present that to me?
gifts.hostile_reply: You will need far more than a trinket to regain my favour.
gifts.trusted_reply: Hmph. Keep it. I am not short of treasures.

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.greeting: State your business. Preferably without causing a scene.
dialogue: Recklessness is for those without responsibilities.
A little caution keeps one alive long enough to reach the next realm.
stronger: Honoured senior, I had not realised the depth of your cultivation.
weaker: It would be wise for you to show restraint.
familiar: We have met before. Let us avoid unnecessary trouble.
challenged: Surely we can put our disagreement behind us.
guided: The instruction is yours. Apply it carefully.
friendly: A sensible ally is worth more than another enemy.
taunts: Think carefully before testing my patience.

greetings: The road ahead is uncertain. Remain vigilant.
wary: Our paths differ. I prefer to keep my distance.
senior: Honoured senior, I intend no offence.

gifts.preferred_reply: A sensible provision. I can see you prepared carefully.
gifts.accepted_reply: Useful. I will keep it for a difficult day.
gifts.refused_reply: I have no need for that. Please keep it.
gifts.disliked_reply: That looks unsafe. I will not touch it.
gifts.hostile_reply: I cannot trust a common offering from you, not yet.
gifts.trusted_reply: You have already earned my trust. Save your supplies.

stern.name: Stern
stern.greeting: Stand straight. What business brings you here?
dialogue: There are no shortcuts around a weak foundation.
stronger: Your cultivation is formidable. Do not let pride spoil it.
weaker: Your realm is insufficient reason to neglect your manners.
familiar: You return. I trust you have not neglected your training.
challenged: A challenge is only meaningful when you learn from it.
guided: I have taught you once. Demonstrate that the lesson was not wasted.
friendly: Your diligence has earned a measure of my approval.

wary: Discipline is more important than the banner you carry.

gifts.preferred_reply: Practical and well chosen. Good judgement, cultivator.
gifts.accepted_reply: An acceptable offering. Now return to your training.
gifts.refused_reply: Spend your resources on useful preparations instead.
gifts.disliked_reply: Do not waste my time with such nonsense.
gifts.hostile_reply: Discipline and deeds must come before gifts.
gifts.trusted_reply: Enough offerings. Show me what you have learned instead.

eccentric.name: Eccentric
eccentric.greeting: Hm? Oh! Another curious soul wandering past my meditation.
dialogue: A falling leaf can teach more than a hundred scriptures.
Have you ever tried cultivating while listening to frogs?
A good question is sometimes worth more than a perfect answer.
stronger: What an extraordinary aura! Perhaps the heavens are feeling playful.
weaker: Do not be discouraged. Even the smallest seed can split stone.
familiar: Back again? I had almost forgotten what we were discussing.
challenged: Our last duel reminded me of a very interesting dream.
guided: The technique is yours. What you discover within it is another matter.
friendly: A kindred spirit! Come, tell me something unexpected.
hostile: That was rather unnecessary, do you not think?

greetings: Have you ever tried circulating qi upside down?
wary: Interesting. Two paths, yet the same heavens above.
senior: Senior, have you discovered any interesting mysteries lately?

gifts.preferred_reply: Magnificent! I wonder what secrets this little curiosity contains.
gifts.accepted_reply: Oh, this could be interesting. Thank you!
gifts.refused_reply: Curious, but not quite the curiosity I was looking for.
gifts.disliked_reply: Even I would rather not experiment with that.
gifts.hostile_reply: An intriguing peace offering. Perhaps you are not beyond hope.
gifts.trusted_reply: Keep it! Bring me an interesting story next time.
